Guys I’m back again 😅🚗💨

Make we run today’s breakdown together 👇

📊 Trips: 8
💰 Total Earnings: ₦84,400
⛽ Fuel: Bought ₦50k (still get like 10 liters left… so roughly today na about ₦40k fuel)

Now the funny (but painful) part 😂😭

Na so I follow Google today like say na my village chief…
Trip wey suppose carry me go Mega Chicken (Okita, Lekki-Epe Expressway)…

Before I know wetin dey happen, I don land for Coaster New Road 😩
Guyyyy I drive pass 12km extra just like that 💀
At that moment, I just weak… I know say I don lose small today 🤦‍♂️
But God dey sha 🙏
Customer sef no stress me — even shock me pass…
Na Philippines client wey I pick from Festac go Mega Chicken… cool and calm 🙌
Lesson of the day:
No trust Google 100% for Lagos ooo 😭
Sometimes ask road, sometimes trust your instinct!

Make we gist 👇
👉 You don ever follow Google enter problem before?
👉 How you dey avoid wrong routes for Lagos?
👉 8 trips = ₦84k… you think say today try or I for push more?

Drop your thoughts my people 💬🔥
